title: DES-62011-compact-glance-inline-explainer-popover-flow-and-qa-handoff
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Background: The Console's Glance cards are increasingly dense; teams repeatedly ask for inline explanations for compact metrics (tokenized cost, token breakdown, rollout state) without leaving the card context. This ticket designs an inline explainer popover pattern for compact glance cards that surfaces concise definitions, a link to the full metric docs, and quick recovery actions for transient rollout 'ghost' states. Goals: (1) reduce cognitive load for new users; (2) keep the interaction lightweight in high-density layouts; (3) meet AA contrast and keyboard/voiceover accessibility; (4) provide a clear handoff to engineering with annotated redlines and QA checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Explainer popover appears on hover and keyboard focus for compact glance cards
Popover content is editable by PMs in Console content editor (rich text + link)
Mobile and collapsed density behave gracefully: tappable affordance with fallback inline label
Contrast and focus ring meet AA requirements for all color themes
Figma prototype (compact density) with hover/focus/keyboard flows linked
QA checklist included and accessible to QE: visual redlines, animation durations, edge cases
design_decisions: Use simple 3-line copy max in popover to avoid layout shift and tokenization issues
Prefer inline chevron affordance over full iconography to save horizontal space
Delay popover open by 180ms on hover to reduce accidental triggers in dense grids
On mobile/very compact states, expose a tappable 'i' micro-button that expands into a bottom-sheet variant
Fallbacks: if the popover target is truncated, expand to full tooltip on long-press or keyboard focus
tradeoffs: Minimizing copy reduces explanatory depth; we prioritize concision and link to deeper docs
Hover delay improves stability but may add perceived latency for power users — keyboard focus opens instantly
Introducing an 'i' affordance increases visual clutter slightly; offset by hiding when card is selected or in edit mode
implementation_notes: Engineering: expose data attributes for tokenized-value and state (data-token, data-rollout-state) so popover copy can reference live values
CSS: use transform-origin + opacity animation (duration 160ms) to avoid layout reflow; avoid scale animation that impacts text legibility
A11y: role=button for the affordance, aria-expanded + aria-controls, and an offscreen label matching visible copy
Testing: Add Percy snapshots for hover, focus, and mobile-sheet variants + VoiceOver walkthrough steps
